description: Pull the fields you name from any public page as JSON, each checked against the page. 5 credits for most pages: the p...

agent.description: Accepted so a client that sends { model: "FIRE-1" } works. An extract reads the pages it is given and checks every value; it does not browse or click, and the answer says so in warning. To navigate a site, use the agent endpoint.

allowExternalLinks.description: Send true to also read pages on other sites that the pages link to, up to 5, picking the links whose address mentions your prompt. Each page read costs 1 credit.

enableWebSearch.description: Send true to also search the web for your prompt and read the best pages it finds, up to 3 more. Needs a prompt. Costs 2 credits for the search. With no urls, the search runs without this.

ignoreInvalidURLs.description: Skip addresses that are not public website URLs. Send false to refuse the call instead.

ignoreSitemap.description: For an address ending in /*: skip the site's sitemaps and find pages by links.

includeSubdomains.description: For an address ending in /*: also read pages on subdomains of the site. Send false to stay on the exact host.

prompt.description: What to pull from the pages in plain words, such as the version and the release date, up to 10000 characters. With no urls, the web is searched for the first 400 characters of it.

schema.description: The fields to fill, as a JSON Schema (draft-07 or 2020-12) object with properties. Pydantic's model_json_schema() and zod's toJSONSchema() output work as they are. enum, const, anyOf, oneOf, nullable types, $ref with $defs, required, descriptions and any key names are read. Up to 100 top-level fields and 32 KB. A field the page does not state comes back null.

scrapeOptions.description: How to read each page, the same options as scrape.

actions.description: Up to 50 steps to run on the page, in order, before reading it: { "type": "wait", "milliseconds": 500 } (up to 30 seconds), { "type": "wait", "selector": ".results" }, { "type": "click", "selector": "button.more" }, { "type": "write", "text": "tides" }, { "type": "press", "key": "Enter" }, { "type": "scroll", "direction": "down" } (also up, left or right; amount is pixels, "viewport" or "max"; maxScrolls 1 to 50; selector scrolls an inner container; "max" keeps scrolling until the page stops growing, for feeds that load as you go), { "type": "screenshot", "fullPage": true } (links come back in actions.screenshots), { "type": "scrape" } (the page at that point, in actions.scrapes), { "type": "executeJavascript", "script": "document.title" } (results in actions.javascriptReturns), { "type": "pdf", "format": "A4" } (links in actions.pdfs) or { "type": "perform", "action": "Click the Load more button" } (a step in plain words, up to 5 browser steps on this page, never leaving the site; at most 5 per call). A read with actions costs 1 credit, the same as any page; the actions themselves add nothing. If an action fails, you still get the page as it stood, with a warning that names the action and says why.

blockAds.description: Ads and trackers are not loaded when a page runs in a browser. Send false to load them.

checkPromptInjection.description: Send true to scan the page text for instructions aimed at an AI model before anything is built from it. A page that has them is refused with 403 promptInjectionDetected and costs nothing. The scan adds 4 credits when it runs; a page it cannot scan fully comes back with a warning and no charge.

excludeTags.description: Remove the parts of the page that match these CSS selectors, such as .comments.

fastMode.description: Send true to read the page without opening a browser: the answer comes sooner, but a page that needs a browser, or that refuses a plain request, comes back as an error instead of being retried. Ignored when the call needs a browser (actions, screenshot, waitFor, mobile, profile, network, branding).

headers.description: Extra request headers to send to the site, such as { "x-plan": "pro" }. A read with headers is never answered from or saved to a stored copy.

includeTags.description: Keep only the parts of the page that match these CSS selectors, such as article or .price. When set, onlyMainContent is not applied.

location.description: Where to read the page from. The default is the United States.

country.description: Two-letter country code to read the page from, such as DE or JP.

languages.description: Languages to ask the site for, best first, such as ["de", "en"]. Sent as Accept-Language. A read with languages is never answered from or saved to a stored copy.

lockdown.description: Send true to answer only from a stored copy of the page and never read it live, whatever its age. A page with no stored copy is notFound. The same as minAge 0.

maxAge.description: Accept a stored answer up to this many milliseconds old, at most 30 days. Without it, 2 days, or less for a site whose pages change often, and a copy up to twice that age (at most 7 days) comes back at once as stale while a fresh read runs. 0 always reads the page live. metadata.cacheState says which one you got.

minAge.description: Answer only from a stored copy that is at least this many milliseconds old, and never read the page live. 0 accepts any stored copy. A page with no such copy is notFound.

mobile.description: Read the page as a phone would: a phone-sized screen and the mobile version of the site. The page loads in a browser.

onlyCleanContent.description: Send true to have a model remove what onlyMainContent leaves behind in the markdown: cookie banners, ads, share widgets, breadcrumbs, sign-up prompts, comment prompts and related-article lists. It only removes whole paragraphs and lists; it never rewrites or adds text, and code blocks are always kept. Skipped with a warning when the page is too long to clean or the model does not answer. Not with zeroDataRetention. Summary, answers and highlights are made from the cleaned markdown.

onlyMainContent.description: Keep only the page's main content, without menus, headers, footers and ads.

parsers.description: Only the pdf parser exists. Send "pdf" or { "type": "pdf", mode, maxPages, pages, blocks, pageMarkers } with the same meaning as in parse. Without mode a PDF is read from its text layer only; auto reads the picture of a page that has no text, and ocr reads the picture of every page, up to 20 pages. Each page of text that comes back costs 1 credit.

blocks.description: Send true to also get the page's layout in blocks: each title, section header or run of text, with its page, reading order, position on the page (bbox as left, top, right, bottom from 0 to 1) and where its text sits in that page's markdown (span, as in pages). Tables, figures and formulas are not told apart. A page read from its picture is one block. No extra charge.

maxPages.description: Read at most this many pages, up to 100.

mode.description: fast reads the text layer only. auto (the default) reads the text layer and reads the picture of any page that has none. ocr reads the picture of every page.

pageMarkers.description: Send true to mark page breaks in the markdown: pages are joined with "---" and a <!-- page N --> line, where N is the page that follows. No extra charge.

pages.description: Send true to also get each page's markdown in pages, as { pageNumber, markdown }. No extra charge.

profile.description: Read the page with the cookies and local storage that earlier calls saved under this name, kept for your account for 30 days after the last use. A call with a profile always loads the page in a browser, costs 1 credit, the same as any page, and is never answered from a stored copy. Only one call at a time can save to a profile.

name.description: A name you choose, such as shop-login. Calls with the same name share state.

saveChanges.description: Keep the cookies and local storage this read leaves behind for the next call with this name. Send false to read with the profile without changing it.

proxy.description: auto: basic first, enhanced once if the site refuses. basic: one plain attempt. enhanced: the stronger read from the start. Same price.

entities.description: What to hide: PERSON, EMAIL, PHONE, LOCATION, FINANCIAL, SECRET. All by default.

mode.description: accurate finds names and places with the model and the rest by pattern. aggressive adds guesses that catch more and may hide a little too much. fast uses patterns only, so it finds no ordinary names or places.

replaceStyle.description: tag writes <EMAIL>, mask writes * for each character, remove deletes it.

redactPII.description: Send true, or an object, to hide personal data in the markdown and in everything made from it (summary, answers, highlights, json). Links, html and rawHtml are not changed. A page the model cannot scan is refused rather than returned unredacted.

removeBase64Images.description: Images inside the page that carry their data in the address (data:image) are dropped by default. Send false to keep them in markdown and html.

skipTlsVerification.description: Send true to read a page whose certificate is expired, self-signed or for another name. The read is not private against someone between us and the site.

storeInCache.description: Send false to neither read nor keep a stored copy of this page.

timeout.description: How long to keep trying, in milliseconds, between 10 seconds and 2 minutes. Pages behind a bot check can need 10 to 30 seconds the first time.

waitFor.description: Extra milliseconds to wait before reading, up to 60000, for pages that load their content late. To wait for an element, add a wait action with a selector. A read that waits costs 1 credit, the same as any page.

zeroDataRetention.description: Send true to keep nothing from this call: no stored copy is read or made, and nothing from it is logged. Costs 1 credit more per page. Not with a screenshot.

showSources.description: Send true to get sources: for each field, the pages that state its value.

systemPrompt.description: Standing instructions for how to fill the fields, such as units or how to write dates, up to 10000 characters. They add to the rules of the extract: a value is still copied from the page and is null when the page does not state it.

urls.description: The pages to read, up to 25, such as ["https://bun.com/blog/bun-v1.3"]. An address ending in /* reads pages under it, found through the site's sitemap. With more than one, the fields are filled from all of them together. A page that cannot be read is skipped and named in warning, and costs nothing. A page is read up to 50000 characters. With several pages each one gets a smaller share, and all together are read up to 150000 characters. A page that is cut is counted in warning. The call fails only when no page can be read. Leave it out and send a prompt to search the web instead.

webhook.description: Where to be told when the extract ends: a plain address, or { url } which gets one JSON POST with the id, the status, the data and creditsUsed. headers are sent with the call, metadata comes back in it, and events picks completed, failed or both (both by default). The call is signed: read Stophy-Signature (t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex>), the HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.<body>" with your webhook secret from webhook.secret. A call that gets no 2xx is sent again, up to 3 times.

zeroDataRetention.description: Send true to keep nothing from this call: pages are read live, the result is held for one hour at most, and nothing is logged. Costs 1 credit more per page.
